specs.title: Scaffold product repo
specs.why: Nothing else can be built until the app skeleton, database client and CI entry points exist.
specs.scope: Create a Next.js 14 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind + Prisma + Postgres application in this repository.
specs.non_goals: Do not modify any file under `.github/` — those workflows are centrally managed.
tasks: Add `prisma/schema.prisma`: add Prisma with a Postgres datasource
Add `/api/health`: create the  route in `app/api/health/route.ts` returning `{ok, version}`
acceptance: `GET /api/health` returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body
`pnpm build` completes and `pnpm dev` starts the server
CI is green on this pull request

specs.title: Database schema v1
specs.why: Every later feature reads or writes these tables, so the model must land before feature work.
specs.scope: Define Prisma models for Tenant, User, Service, Staff, BusinessHour, Client, Booking, Payment and AuditLog. All tenant-owned rows carry `tenantId` with an index.
tasks: Add `prisma/schema.prisma`: define the nine models with relations
Write `prisma/seed.ts` creating one demo tenant and 3 services
acceptance: `pnpm prisma migrate dev` applies without error
`pnpm prisma db seed` inserts the demo tenant, verified by query
